comment: Single source of truth for which profile may claim which ISA extension. Derived from docs/implementation-plan.md section 1.1 (profile table) and section 3.2.1 (RVA23S64 obligations). A profile may claim an extension only if min_profile is at or below it AND every listed impl/verify task exists in docs. 'advertise' is what the build manifest is allowed to publish in misa / compiler -march / reference capability; a capability is only advertised once its implementation tasks have delivered.

capabilities.name: I
capabilities.spec_clause: RV64I base integer instruction set, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: M
capabilities.spec_clause: RV64M integer multiply/divide, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: Zicsr
capabilities.spec_clause: Control and status register instructions, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: Zifencei
capabilities.spec_clause: Instruction-fetch fence, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: Zicntr
capabilities.spec_clause: Base counters (cycle/time/instret), implied by Zicsr, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: Zihpm
capabilities.spec_clause: Hardware performance counters, read-only zero when no counters are implemented

capabilities.name: A
capabilities.spec_clause: Atomic memory operations incl. LR/SC, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: C
capabilities.spec_clause: Compressed instructions, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: S
capabilities.spec_clause: Supervisor privilege, privileged spec v1.12

capabilities.name: U
capabilities.spec_clause: User privilege, privileged spec v1.12

capabilities.name: PMP
capabilities.spec_clause: Physical memory protection, privileged spec v1.12

capabilities.name: Sv39
capabilities.spec_clause: Sv39 address translation, privileged spec v1.12

capabilities.name: Sv48
capabilities.spec_clause: Sv48 address translation; S64 option, only claimed if explicitly selected

capabilities.name: F
capabilities.spec_clause: Single-precision floating point, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: D
capabilities.spec_clause: Double-precision floating point, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: V
capabilities.spec_clause: Vector extension 1.0, VLEN>=128, ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: Zve64d
capabilities.spec_clause: Embedded vector profile implied by V with ELEN=64; advertised only with V

capabilities.name: Zicsr_Zifencei_pairing
capabilities.spec_clause: RVA23 requires both Zicsr and Zifencei; neither may be claimed alone

capabilities.name: Zkt
capabilities.spec_clause: Data-independent execution latency, scalar subset; ISA manual v20260120

capabilities.name: Zvkt
capabilities.spec_clause: Data-independent execution latency for implemented vector instructions

capabilities.name: Zicfilp
capabilities.spec_clause: Code integrity: landing pad (LFENCE/branch target enforcement)

capabilities.name: Zicfiss
capabilities.spec_clause: Code integrity: shadow stack

capabilities.name: Zimop
capabilities.spec_clause: May-Be-Operations; RVA23U64 mandatory

capabilities.name: Zcmop
capabilities.spec_clause: Compressed May-Be-Operations; RVA23U64 mandatory

capabilities.name: Zaamo
capabilities.spec_clause: Atomic memory ordering for address-only operations; mandatory when A is claimed

capabilities.name: Zalrsc
capabilities.spec_clause: Atomic memory ordering for LR/SC; mandatory when A is claimed

capabilities.name: Zicbom
capabilities.spec_clause: Cache block management operations (CBO.INVAL/CLEAN/FLUSH/ZAO)

capabilities.name: Zicbop
capabilities.spec_clause: Cache block prefetch operations

capabilities.name: Zicond
capabilities.spec_clause: Integer conditional move instructions

capabilities.name: Zmmul
capabilities.spec_clause: Low-width multiply only; subset of M

capabilities.name: PMLEN0
capabilities.spec_clause: Supm/Ssnpm pointer masking with PMLEN=0, mandatory minimum

capabilities.name: PMLEN7
capabilities.spec_clause: Supm/Ssnpm pointer masking with PMLEN=7, mandatory minimum

capabilities.name: CMO
capabilities.spec_clause: Cache management operations with coherent PMA, RVA23U64 mandatory

capabilities.name: Sha
capabilities.spec_clause: Hypervisor extension: eight separately accepted sub-obligations, tracked per sub-item in I-092
